@@CASE 1|x = cell2mat({1 2; 3 4})

x =

     1     2
     3     4

@@CLASS double [2 2]
@@END
@@CASE 2|x = cell2mat({[1 2], [3]; [4 5], [6]})

x =

     1     2     3
     4     5     6

@@CLASS double [2 3]
@@END
@@CASE 3|x = cell2mat({[1;2], [3;4]})

x =

     1     3
     2     4

@@CLASS double [2 2]
@@END
@@CASE 4|x = cell2mat({})

x =

     []

@@CLASS double [0 0]
@@END
@@CASE 5|x = cell2mat({'ab', 'cd'})

abcd

@@CLASS char [1 4]
@@END

@@END

@@END
